title: Quantifying knowledge synchronisation in the 21st century
reasoning: The paper discusses the structure and diffusion of general knowledge, using epistemology (e.g., mentioning Kant) as a brief historical framing for the concept of knowledge itself. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical knowledge systems as a substantive part of its analysis. The core of the paper is a quantitative analysis of knowledge similarity based on Wikipedia structures and its correlation with socio-economic factors, focusing on the domain of 'science & technology'.
